keyPoints: Bahubhuj ke vikarn (diagonals) aamne-saamne ke sheershon ko jodte hain; n bhuja wale bahubhuj ke antar konon ka yog (n-2) x 180 hota hai.
Chaturbhuj ke chaaron konon ka yog 360 hota hai — teen kon 90, 90, 100 hon to chautha 80 — chaaron ka yog 360 se zyada ya kam nahi ho sakta.
Samantar chaturbhuj me aamne-saamne ki bhujaen barabar-samantar, aamne-saamne ke kon barabar, aur vikarn ek-doosre ko samdvibhajit karte hain.
Samachaturbhuj (rhombus) ke vikarn ek-doosre ko samkon par kaatte hain; aayat ke vikarn barabar hote hain; varg me dono gun hote hain.
Samalamb (trapezium) me ek yugm bhujaen samantar hoti hain; patang (kite) me aasann bhujaon ke do yugm barabar hote hain.
Bahya konon ka yog hamesha 360 hota hai — chahe bahubhuj kitni bhi bhujaon ka ho, ye uska sthir gun hai.
Aam galti: har chaturbhuj ko samantar chaturbhuj samajhna — samantar chaturbhuj ke liye dono yugm bhujaon ka samantar hona zaroori hai.
subject: Maths
title: Chaturbhujon ko Samajhna
